name: claude-cost-guard
description: Daily and weekly token budgets for Claude Code from your local transcripts, with zero-token warnings and an optional hard stop.

plugins.name: spendcap
plugins.description: A hook that checks your spending against daily and weekly budgets before every prompt: a warning line (shown to you, never sent to the model) at 50%, 80% and 100%, and in hard mode a block once the budget is used. Costs no tokens.
